name: @nicotind/capacitor-tv-channels
description: Android TV launcher integration: publishes the current track to the Google TV Play Next (Watch Next) row and bridges the Assistant's MEDIA_PLAY_FROM_SEARCH intent to the web app. Android-only by construction (no ios src); every method no-ops off TV via a UiModeManager gate. There is no JS package to import — the web app reaches it through the injected Capacitor.Plugins.NicotindTvChannels global (see packages/web services/native/tv-channels.service.ts).
